label: The first stage
title: Laying the Foundation
intro: Every wall, roof and room of the Kpotamé health center will rest on its foundation, so that is where the building begins. Lot 1 covers clearing and setting up the site, excavating the trenches and pits, and the reinforced concrete and masonry that carry everything above it.
promise: Seven stages build the Kpotamé health center. This campaign lays the first.
photo_alt: The cleared ground for the Kpotamé health center: bare red earth marked by machine tracks, a trench of standing water in front, trees and village houses behind.
budget_intro: This is the whole construction estimate, lot by lot, with the 10 percent reserve on its own line so you can see exactly what it is.
estimate_summary_sub: Every lot, the reserve and the total, line by line

goal_basis.lot_only: The goal is Lot 1, the foundation works.
goal_basis.with_reserve: The goal is Lot 1 plus its {reserve_percent} percent reserve.
goal_basis.all_in: The goal is Lot 1 plus its {reserve_percent} percent reserve and {vat_percent}% VAT.

reserve_note: Kept for technical adjustments and price changes
vat_note: *VAT at {vat_percent}% is shown as its own line. If an exemption is granted, this line is removed and the totals drop by the same amount.
construction_note: This table covers the construction works only.

building.label: The building
building.title: What your gift will build
building.intro: These are the health center's own drawings, prepared for APED. One level, about 28 by 34 meters, with wards for mothers, children, women and men, a delivery room, a pharmacy and a laboratory.
building.render_alt: Drawing of the finished Kpotamé health center: a long, white single-story building with a red tile roof, a gabled entrance marked Centre de Santé with two red crosses, wide steps, and palm trees on each side.
building.render_caption: Artist's impression of the finished health center, Kpotamé, Assahoun, Togo.
building.plan_alt: Floor plan of the health center, labeled in French: wards along the top and right, a central patio, consultation rooms on the left, and the pharmacy and veranda at the bottom right.

rooms.items: Delivery room, maternity ward, midwife, prenatal consultations
Consultation, nurse, treatment room, minor surgery, women's ward, men's ward
Pharmacy and its store, laboratory, sample collection

building.foundation_plan_alt: The foundation plan of the health center: the outline of every wall drawn on a measured grid.
building.foundation_text: The foundation plan. Every room above sits on what is drawn here, and building it is Lot 1, the first stage this campaign raises for.

first_block.label: Lay the First Block
first_block.text: You can give a named block of the foundation; a donor-name monument is planned for the site, but which gifts will be engraved on it has not been decided yet.
